meta.title: Suggestions and decision log
meta.purpose: A reviewable queue of proposed improvements. Each item can be accepted, rejected or deferred, and the decision is recorded so the same proposal is not re-litigated.

rubric.impact: 1 = cosmetic, 3 = changes what a reader can conclude, 5 = changes whether the product can exist
rubric.effort: 1 = under an hour, 3 = about a day, 5 = multi-session
rubric.confidence: how sure we are that the impact claim is true, 0-100. Anything below 60 is an experiment, not a plan.

suggestions.title: Publish a one-line provenance tag on every figure
suggestions.problem: A dashboard that mixes verified and assumed numbers is worse than no dashboard, because readers cannot tell which is which.
suggestions.proposal: Every table row links to its source. Any value that could not be verified is blank with a visible 'unverified' marker.
suggestions.evidence: Implemented in scripts/verify.py, which fails the build on a blank source id.

suggestions.title: Separate availability from depth ordering
suggestions.problem: Ourlads and nfl.com disagreed 14 times in a single week. Merging them silently produces a confidently wrong answer.
suggestions.proposal: Official NFL report owns availability. Ourlads owns depth order. Disagreements are published, not averaged.
suggestions.decision: Accepted and implemented. Awaiting reviewer confirmation (Q-05).

suggestions.title: Ship an empty leaderboard instead of a fabricated one
suggestions.problem: A seeded leaderboard with plausible-looking ROI is the easiest way to make the whole project untrustworthy.
suggestions.proposal: Show the gate machinery and state plainly that no strategy has been graded.

suggestions.title: Pre-register the skill thresholds before seeing results
suggestions.problem: Thresholds picked after the results are not evidence, they are curve-fitting.
suggestions.proposal: Ratify the luck-removal pass rules (L1, L4, L5 + bootstrap) now, in writing, before any bet is graded.
suggestions.evidence: Q-08 asks for exactly this sign-off.
suggestions.decision: Deferred to the user. This is the highest-value five-minute action available.

suggestions.title: Get one timestamped closing line before building anything else
suggestions.problem: Four strategies and the entire leaderboard are blocked on the same missing input.
suggestions.proposal: Obtain a licensed odds source. It unblocks G4, STR-08, CLV, and any market-comparison page.
suggestions.decision: Deferred - requires a decision only the user can make.

suggestions.title: Replace draft pedigree with snap counts in the exposure index
suggestions.problem: Pedigree measures draft status, not current ability.
suggestions.proposal: Swap the pedigree weight for a snap-share weight once snap data exists. Keep the formula shape, change one input.

suggestions.title: Add a staleness banner driven by the as-of date
suggestions.proposal: Every page prints the capture date and warns when the data is older than 7 days.

suggestions.title: Treat reported injury status as missing data, not as 'healthy'
suggestions.problem: 107 transcribed players carry no official designation. Calling them healthy would invent 107 facts.
suggestions.proposal: A third state, 'no designation published', distinct from both Out and playing.

suggestions.title: Score the leaderboard on risk-adjusted, deflated returns
suggestions.problem: Ranking by raw ROI rewards the luckiest high-variance strategy.
suggestions.proposal: Rank on ROI/stdev, deflated for the number of strategies tried.
suggestions.decision: Accepted as a design. Not yet exercised because no bets are graded.

suggestions.title: Split the site by audience
suggestions.problem: One long page serves neither a reader who wants the conclusion nor one who wants to audit a row.
suggestions.proposal: Dashboard for conclusions, per-category subpages for detail, a separate Flagged page for anything unresolved.

suggestions.title: Automate the weekly refresh with an explicit failure state
suggestions.problem: Manual refresh will be skipped, and a silent skip is the worst outcome.
suggestions.proposal: A scheduled job that re-captures S02/S04, diffs against the previous snapshot, and fails loudly if a source shape changes.
suggestions.decision: Deferred - external fetch is tool-mediated here, so the job cannot run unattended in this environment.

suggestions.title: Grade injury signals against the inactives list
suggestions.problem: A 'Questionable' player is currently neither in nor out, so injury signals cannot be scored.
suggestions.proposal: Capture the 90-minute inactives list each week and use it as the grading truth.
suggestions.decision: Deferred, but this is the cheapest way to make STR-03 testable.

decision_log.rationale: Directly serves the verification requirement; no external dependency.
Each needs either a user decision, a licence, or data this environment cannot reach. Recorded rather than silently skipped.
